app.name: Syncvault
app.tagline: All your clouds, in sync. Only you hold the key.

tray_notice.title: Tray icon not available
tray_notice.body: Your desktop does not show tray icons. On GNOME, enable the “AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support” extension. Until then, closing the window minimises Syncvault.

welcome.title: Welcome to Syncvault
welcome.body: Set up your master password, add a cloud account and choose a folder to keep encrypted and in sync.
welcome.previewNotice: Preview: this setup is not secure yet. Nothing is encrypted or saved.

password.title: Create your master password
password.body: This password unlocks Syncvault and encrypts your files. Only you know it.
password.label: Master password
password.hint: At least {{min}} characters. A few random words make a strong, memorable password.
password.warning: We can't reset this password. If you lose both it and your recovery key, your encrypted files can't be recovered.

recoveryKey.title: Save your recovery key
recoveryKey.body: If you forget your master password, this key is the only way back in. Store it somewhere safe and offline, like a password manager or on paper.
recoveryKey.label: Recovery key
recoveryKey.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please select the key and copy it manually.
recoveryKey.confirm: I have saved my recovery key somewhere safe

done.title: You're set up
done.body: Next, connect a cloud account like Google Drive or OneDrive.
